description: Lists the claims in the person’s Untap account with amounts, deadlines, the verdict and their progress (not sent, sent, paid, rejected or archived). By default it shows claims that are still open; include_closed adds paid, rejected and archived ones. Requires sign-in to Untap.

category.description: Restricts the list to one category. When left out, all categories are listed.

include_closed.description: Also show claims marked paid, rejected or archived, and ones with nothing to claim.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Defaults to 25.

name: list_my_claims
title: List my claims
